dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a new pair of shoes. I want something that's casual, rugged, and durable — a solid all-around shoe I can wear for different occasions. What do you have that fits that description? Also, I've got a budget of around $200 to $500.
dialogue.agent:
Here are a couple of options in your budget that lean into durable, rugged territory:

1. **Allen Edmonds Men's McAllister Wing Tip** — $248.14 | ⭐ 4.3/5 (100 reviews) — A premium, handcrafted leather wing tip shoe. It's more of a dress-casual style, built with high-quality leather and 212-step construction, so it's extremely durable. Great for occasions from office to dinner out.

2. **BOGS Mens Foundation Leather Low Composite Toe Boots** — $235.94 | ⭐ 4.3/5 (6 reviews) — Waterproof, rugged work-style boots built for tough conditions. Very durable and functional, though more on the utility/outdoor side.

Would either of these styles appeal to you, or are you looking for something more specific?

dialogue.user:
Hmm, the Allen Edmonds wing tip sounds nice, but it's a bit more dressy than what I'm looking for. And the BOGS boots are a bit too utility-focused for me. 

Do you have anything that's a bit more of a middle ground? Like a rugged casual shoe that's good for everyday wear but still built to last. Also, I should mention — I'm looking for shoes with an average rating of at least 5 out of 5. Can you check if anything meets that rating?
dialogue.agent:
Great question! I checked the inventory, and unfortunately there are **no shoes with an average rating of exactly 5.0/5** in your price range — or anywhere in the inventory, actually. The highest average ratings I can find are around 4.5–4.6 out of 5. Would you be open to considering shoes with excellent ratings in that 4.5+ range?

If so, I found a couple of options that might be that rugged-casual middle ground you're after:

1. **Thursday Boot Company Men's President Ankle Boot** — **$199.00** | ⭐ 4.5/5 (199 reviews) — A very popular rugged boot that's casual enough for everyday wear but polished enough for nicer occasions. It's a classic style that's built to last.

2. **Cole Haan Men's Grnd Plus Essex Wedgechukka Chukka Boot** — **$129.59** | ⭐ 4.6/5 (35 reviews) — A rugged but refined chukka boot with sneaker-like comfort technology. Great for daily wear with jeans or chinos.

Would you like me to pull up more details or reviews on either of these?

products.title: Cole Haan Men's Grnd Plus Essex Wedgechukka Chukka Boot
products.description: Cole Haan was founded on the principles of providing elegantly innovative footwear, resulting in sophisticated shoes with a sneaker-like feel. This pair of chukka boots is no exception and has been expertly crafted in a ruggedly handsome materials that pair just as well with chinos and a sweater for work or denim and a flannel on the weekend. Built with our grand's technology in the outsole for all-day comfort and energy return. With nearly 80 years in the business and hundreds of points of distribution in the U.S., Cole Haan is one of America's premier luxury brands. Founded in 1928 as a collaboration between Trafton Cole and Eddie Haan, Cole Haan epitomized artisan quality and impeccable craftsmanship during a time when style was everything. Originally, Cole Haan was a men's footwear label that captured the essence of the 20s spirit with beautifully-designed and well-made shoes for the dapper gentleman. Today, Cole Haan brings that heritage to all of its products, including men's and women's dress and casual footwear, belts, hosiery, handbags, small leather goods, outerwear and sunglasses.
